title: Financial services
description: Adapt reviews to banks, insurers, payment and investment firms and the ICT providers that serve them.
context: Ask the compliance owner whether the organization is a financial entity under DORA (Regulation (EU) 2022/2554) and which competent authority supervises it. This sector preselects the dora-financial-entity pattern; decline DORA when it is out of scope.
Name the owners of ICT risk, incident reporting and ICT third-party contracts before changing a system that supports a critical or important function.
Record which payment, customer or market data the change touches and the retention rules that apply to it.

Directive (EU) 2019/882, the European Accessibility Act, covers consumer banking services (point d) provided to consumers after 28 June 2025 (Art. 2(2)), the date from which national laws apply it (Art. 31(2)); micro-enterprises providing services are exempt (Art. 4(5)). This sector preselects the european-accessibility-act pattern.

sources.title: Directive (EU) 2019/882 on the accessibility requirements for products and services (European Accessibility Act)
